report.headline: Maximum NSW1 operational demand was 11,079.0 MW at 2026-07-29 19:00 AEST (interval ending 2026-07-29T09:00:00Z) [ev0038].
summary: The half-hour maximum operational demand in NSW1 during 2026-07-29 00:00–24:00 local was 11,079.0 MW (interval ending 2026-07-29T09:00:00Z).
The half-hour that contains the price peak (5-minute peak interval ending 2026-07-29T10:05:00Z / 2026-07-29 20:05 AEST) had operational demand 10,846.0 MW (half-hour ending 2026-07-29T10:30:00Z).
Neighbouring half-hour operational-demand values in the actual series include 10,980.0 MW (interval end 2026-07-29T08:30:00Z) and 11,034.0 MW (interval end 2026-07-29T09:30:00Z).
The 5-minute regional peak RRP was 147.88 $/MWh at interval end 2026-07-29T10:05:00Z (2026-07-29 20:05 AEST); dispatch TOTALDEMAND at that 5-minute interval was 10,761.01 MW.
No 5-minute intervals met the project analysis high-price threshold of 300.0 $/MWh (count 0), and there were 20 five-minute intervals below the low-price threshold of 0.0 $/MWh.

AEMO market notices retrieved for NSW1 and this window include a NON-CONFORMANCE notice for 29 July 2026 and an Inter-regional transfer limit variation notice (Directlink) returned by the public evidence search.

possible_explanations.statement: An inter-regional transfer limit variation (the Directlink notice [market_notice_144695#0]) might be relevant to net interchange and therefore the dispatch balance at peak times.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare interconnector transfer limit records and actual net interchange with dispatch NETINTERCHANGE at 2026-07-29T10:05:00Z (2026-07-29 20:05 AEST; net interchange evidence ev0771) and the half-hour operational-demand series for the surrounding half-hours.

possible_explanations.statement: Higher-than-forecast operational demand in the evening half-hours might have contributed to the observed maximum; public operational-demand forecasts (POE50 runs) showed values near the observed peak.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare the sequence of public forecast runs' POE50 values with the actual half-hour operational-demand series for 2026-07-29T08:30:00Z–2026-07-29T10:30:00Z (tool times returned in forecast and actual series).
